plan.title: eRFX project-level required and optional T&C acceptance

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Set the project title required for publishing.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage as specified.
Apply the RFQ template and sheet configuration to the RFQ stage.
Select the offered RFQ pricing template.
Add the CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Complete remaining required pricing-sheet fields before publishing.

args.goal: On the eRFX create screen, open Add T&Cs, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set Payment within 45 days to Required, leave Delivery within 7 days as None, click Done, and stop on the create screen.

steps.note: Configure the project-level required and optional clauses.
Add one QA test vendor to the RFQ.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ project.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open this event's RFQ bid sheet as the vendor.
Confirm the required project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Confirm the optional project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Ensure the required clause remains unaccepted for the blocked-submission check.
Accept only the optional clause.
Verify that submitting a quote is blocked while the required clause is unchecked.
Accept the required clause after the blocked submission.
Submit the quote at 100 for the line item after all required clauses are accepted.
Confirm that the vendor bid was successfully submitted.
